TEXTKIT-106: @vera - thanks for the review. The acceptance tests (test_transpositions) require adjacent transpositions to cost 1 (e.g. 'teh'→'the'==1, 'ab'→'ba'==1), and the ticket title is 'typo-tolerant edit distance'. This is the Damerau-Levenshtein variant agreed in design review. I've updated the docstring to mention transpositions explicitly. Please re-review when you get a chance - release cut is cycle 23.
